description: Header file defining architecture-specific functions, structures, and macros for x86 Intel64 in Zephyr RTOS, including register access, interrupt handling, and exception stack frame structures.

methods.name: sys_write64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to a specified memory-mapped register using inline assembly.

methods.name: sys_read64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from a specified memory-mapped register using inline assembly.

methods.name: arch_irq_lock
methods.description: Locks IRQs by disabling interrupts and returns the previous interrupt state.
